summary: A family's mourning, a wary spouse and a sibling working the phones shape whether and when the player can say yes.
realLife: As Joe Biden weighed a 2016 run after his son Beau's death, he said the question was whether his family could take on an arduous commitment. People close to Jill Biden said she shared his doubts though she would not block him. Another son contacted possible supporters, his sister was deeply involved, and a family friend expected a long, thoughtful process.
gates: A death in the household or close family in the last year.
The player is being urged to file.
inGame: Death records and mourning in the household, kin ties to a sibling and grown child, and the party asking a member to run.

turns.what: The family wants him to run to honor the dead, and urges him on.
turns.writesBack: Higher filing intent; a stated purpose on the player.

turns.what: The window closes while the family is still deciding.
turns.writesBack: The player does not file; the gap is remembered.

turns.what: The sibling takes on the groundwork while the player decides.
turns.writesBack: A staffing tie from the sibling to a committee.
